Thanks Sasha — attaching this into the procurement ticket now. Quick clarifying questions so finance can push the PO through: 

1) On the W-8BEN-E you filled the W-8BEN-E entity checkbox but left the US EIN blank. Do you have a US EIN for any of the NordicCloud entities, or should we map payments to the UK subsidiary (no EIN)? We need to know whether to withhold backup withholding.

2) The Certificate of Incumbency looks good — is Oliver Madsen the authorized signer for entering commercial contracts (PO >= $25k)? If not, can you confirm who signs commercial agreements and provide a brief delegation letter?

3) Our AP team needs a KYC field: please provide company registered number (you included 04567892 — can you confirm that's the Companies House number) and a billing address for the invoice.

If you can reply to these three items and re-send an updated W-8 (or a short note that no US EIN exists and payments should be treated as foreign entity), we can complete the PO creation flow and route through Karthik for final approval. If easier, we can accept a notarized delegating letter in place of a fresh W-8.

I'll loop Karthik for final go/no-go on PO release.

Best,
